title: Epic: Authorized Instacart shopping-plan handoff
body:
**Outcome:** an approved Grocery Butler shopping plan can produce an official Instacart Marketplace shopping-list link, without Grocery Butler claiming that checkout, ordering or fulfillment happened.

Instacart becomes the first concrete implementation of the retailer-neutral fulfillment adapter from ADR 0001 (backlog P1.11). It must not leapfrog canonical shopping plans, immutable approvals or the adapter boundary; otherwise private Safeway coupling is just swapped for official Instacart coupling.

## Verified provider behavior (official docs, read 2026-11-25)
- One endpoint: `POST /idp/v1/products/products_link`. Development host `connect.dev.instacart.tools`, production host `connect.instacart.com` ([create shopping list page](https://docs.instacart.com/developer_platform_api/api/products/create_shopping_list_page)).
- Request: `title` and `line_items` required; optional `expires_in` (days, max 365, **no default for shopping lists**), `instructions`, `image_url`, `link_type`, and `landing_page_configuration.partner_linkback_url`. `enable_pantry_items` is documented as recipe-only.
- Line items: `name` (required, used as the search term), `display_text`, `line_item_measurements` (preferred; top-level `quantity`/`unit` are marked deprecated), `upcs` or `product_ids` (mutually exclusive), and `filters.brand_filters` / `filters.health_filters`. Filters are **ignored when UPCs or product IDs are given**. Health filters are a closed set: ORGANIC, GLUTEN_FREE, FAT_FREE, VEGAN, KOSHER, SUGAR_FREE, LOW_FAT.
- Response: `200` with `products_link_url` only. Documented errors: `400` (codes 9999, 1001) and `429` (retry later, no numeric limit given).
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <key>`; development and production keys. The overview page says to contact an Instacart representative, while the API-keys page describes self-service dashboard keys; production approval isn't documented.
- **Not documented on the pages read:** checkout or payment by API, access to the household's Instacart account, order history or status, cart reads, webhooks, guaranteed product matching, partner-chosen retailer. The user picks the store, reviews matches, and checks out in Instacart.

So the adapter's honest capability is "create a shareable shopping-list link". It does not get `read_cart` or `read_order`.

## Workflow
1. Grocery Butler builds and stores a versioned, retailer-neutral shopping plan.
2. The household explicitly approves a fulfillment handoff for that plan version.
3. The Instacart adapter translates approved lines into documented `products_link` fields.
4. Instacart returns a shareable link; Grocery Butler shows "Review in Instacart".
5. The user chooses a store, resolves matches and checks out in Instacart.
6. Grocery Butler records only that a handoff was created, opened, expired or failed.
7. Received goods are reconciled separately; creating a link never changes inventory.

## Prerequisites (outside this epic)
- [ ] #133 Canonical HouseholdItem identity
- [ ] #143 Versioned shopping-plan builder (P1.8)
- [ ] #137 Immutable, expiring approval envelopes (P0.9)
- [ ] #144 Retailer-neutral adapter interface and universal export (P1.11, P1.12)
- [ ] #145 Hard constraints vs soft preferences (P1.9)
- [ ] #136 Capability API v2 (P0.8): the handoff capability lands there

## Children (in order)
- [ ] #139 Discovery and integration decision (rewritten; research, no code)
- [ ] #146 Instacart adapter tracer skeleton (fake transport, stubbed handoff)
- [ ] #147 Translate approved plan lines into `products_link` line items

## Done when
The end-to-end scenario in #148 passes against a fake transport, a dogfood run produces a real development-key link once #139 permits it, and the universal export still works with Instacart disabled.
